title: Hha:s Smithing In Crafting Tables
description: A pack that  adds 9 shapeless crafting recipies that allow smithing in a crafting table
body:
# What it adds:
Shapeless crafting recipies that allow you to do netherite upgrades in a crafting table eg
Upgrade Template + Diamond Chestplate + Netherite Ingot-> Netherite Chestplate
# How its useful
It allows you to auto-upgrade as the smithing table doesent allow that, this is especially useful in the create mod as you can do Automated Shapeless Crafting with the mixer.
# Search keywords
Datapack netherite upgrade crafting table automated smithing table allow upgrading create
